Exclamatory sentences What / How · 阶段复盘: Exclamatory sentences start with What or How: What a/an + adjective + singular noun; How + adjective.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。

What a/an + adjective + singular noun|What + adjective + plural noun|How + adjective/adorb + subject + verb|the exclamatory word must be placed before the phrase it modifies|an exclamatory sentence can omit the subject and verb
